title: Objectives menu Is not visible
symptom: After installing the pumpcontrol apk, the objectives menu is not visible and the user cannot unlock SMB loop.
cause: The pumpcontrol app is only for pump control and does not include the full AAPS functionality such as objectives.
fix: Build and install the signed AAPS APK yourself following the instructions, then import settings from pumpcontrol if possible.
evidence_quote: This app is only for pump control. You need to follow instructions below and build the signed apk for AAPS yourself.
